def transform(grid):
    # Move the shape from one side of the vertical marker to the other,
    # preserving rows and reflecting its horizontal placement. Draw 8 immediately
    # beside the shape on the original side of the marker.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    # background dominates; separator is uniform different color
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    obj = next(x for x in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if x not in (bg, grid[0][sep]))
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    if maxc < sep:
        # reflect around separator; object lands same distance on opposite side
        moved = [(r, 2*sep-1-c) for r,c in cells]
        stripe = min(c for r,c in cells)-1
    else:
        moved = [(r, 2*sep-1-c) for r,c in cells]
        stripe = max(c for r,c in cells)+1
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in moved: g[r][c] = obj
    if 0 <= stripe < w:
        for r in range(h): g[r][stripe] = 8
    return g

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    separator_col = next(c for c in range(w)
                         if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                         and grid[0][c] != background)
    separator = grid[0][separator_col]
    object_color = next(v for v in counts if v not in (background, separator))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == object_color]
    left, right = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    # Shift the object so its nearest edge is one cell from the divider.
    if right < separator_col:
        shift = separator_col - 1 - right
        stripe = left + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = separator_col + 1 - left
        stripe = right + shift + 1

    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c + shift] = object_color
    if 0 <= stripe < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
